explanation: Sodium sulphate and barium chloride exchange ions completely, producing an insoluble white precipitate of barium sulphate alongside dissolved sodium chloride.

beaker_view.initial_appearance: Two colourless solutions: sodium sulphate and barium chloride.
beaker_view.final_appearance: A colourless solution with a dense white precipitate suspended in it.
beaker_view.observation: Mixing the two colourless solutions immediately produces a thick white precipitate of barium sulphate.
